title: Interim placement of module-owned P2 types
question: Where do module-owned types that P2 creates or renames (ScopesPlugin, Scopes\Internal\*, Audit\AuditOptions, Audit\Internal\*) live before P3 adds the module autoload roots, and how do the P1 ownership scans see them?

options.text: P2 gives them their type-map target FQCN and places the file where the existing PSR-4 root AzGuard\ → packages/core/src puts it (src/Scopes/..., src/Audit/...); P3 relocates the files to packages/core/modules/<module>/src with the FQCN unchanged. tests/Arch/Ownership resolves a production file missing from the oracle paths by the FQCN it declares; new interim directories enter i5.json with owner P3
Add the module PSR-4 roots in P2 and create the files in modules/<module>/src
Keep current FQCNs in P2 and rename in P3

context: Type-map rows new/rename/split with phase P2 or P2/P3 name module FQCNs, while P2#scope excludes moving files into modules/ roots (P3). The P1 test 'has an owner for every production file' resolves files only by current_path/target_path.
decision: A — P2 gives them their type-map target FQCN and places the file where the existing PSR-4 root AzGuard\ → packages/core/src puts it (src/Scopes/..., src/Audit/...); P3 relocates the files to packages/core/modules/<module>/src with the FQCN unchanged. tests/Arch/Ownership resolves a production file missing from the oracle paths by the FQCN it declares; new interim directories enter i5.json with owner P3
rationale: Keeps the type-map FQCNs final from P2 on and P3 a pure file move, as the type map's relocate action and P2#scope.exclude require; option B moves files in P2 (excluded), option C changes module FQCNs twice.
consequences: Module FQCNs change once (in P2); P3 moves files only.
i5.json gains packages/core/src/Audit with owner P3; the P3 exit empties it.
